label: 00 / THE PROBLEM

label: 01 / REPLY INSTANTLY
say: One: reply instantly. Every enquiry, from property portals or WhatsApp, lands in your C R M, and AI replies right away, in your style.
text: One: reply instantly. Every enquiry, from property portals or WhatsApp, lands in your CRM, and AI replies right away, in your style.

label: 02 / QUALIFY
say: Two: qualify. AI asks about budget, location, timeline, and if they need a home loan.

label: 03 / ROUTE + BOOK
say: Three: route and book. Serious buyers alert you on WhatsApp. You approve, and the site visit lands in your calendar.

label: 04 / STAY WARM
say: Four: follow up. Not ready yet? Friendly check-ins and new matching properties keep them interested.

label: 05 / RELIABILITY
say: The key? Portals, C R M and calendar connected, clear rules, and you approving what matters.
